title: Lays of Ancient Rome
author: Macaulay, Thomas Babington Macaulay, Baron
description: "Lays of Ancient Rome" by Baron Thomas Babington Macaulay Macaulay is a collection of narrative poems published in 1842.
longDescription: Four lays recreate heroic episodes from early Roman history—including Horatius's legendary defense of a bridge against an Etruscan army and Virginia's tragic sacrifice that sparked political revolution.

authorInfo.bio: Macaulay, Thomas Babington Macaulay, Baron (1800–1859) wrote Lays of Ancient Rome. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
